blocks.title: tevm-effect factory
blocks.text: Effect-native, aggressively dependency-injected TEVM powered by ZEVM and Voltaire, written in VibeLang for Effect 4. Incremental build, typecheck, lint, format, and vitest targets replay from the Smithers cache; reviews enforce Layer DI, scoped EVM mutations, and JSON-RPC parity.
